-------- Forwarded Message --------
Subject: Re: Namgis First Nation R work
Date: Wed, 2 Oct 2019 15:16:21 -0300
From: Sean Godwin <sean....@gmail.com>
To: Alex Mandel <aima...@ucdavis.edu>

Hi all,

The 'Namgis First Nation <http://www.namgis.bc.ca/> is in urgent need of
someone to fill a four-week contract starting immediately. The work is part
of the Broughton Aquaculture Transition Plan
<https://news.gov.bc.ca/releases/2018PREM0151-002412>, and would involve
aggregating parasite data from numerous spreadsheets of raw data from
salmon-farm companies.

The only job requirements are data manipulation skills in R and the time
this month to do the work. Pay is $25/hr and the work can be done from
anywhere. Start date is immediate (actually) and it's a full-time contract
for 4 weeks.

This might be a good short-term gig for a recently-graduated student. I'd
very much appreciate if you could share this widely and forward this on to
potential candidates.

Please contact me, Sean Godwin, at sean....@gmail.com if interested.

Thank you!
-Sean
